name: Flowsery
description:
Query privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics directly from Claude Code. A Google Analytics alternative with real-time visitor data, traffic breakdowns, revenue attribution, and full visitor profiles.

Key features:
- Real-time active visitor count with geographic map
- Site overview, time series, and 24 breakdown dimensions (pages, referrers, countries, devices, browsers, UTM params, channels, and more)
- Visitor profiles with full activity timelines, identity, and revenue
- Goal tracking and custom event recording
- Revenue tracking with auto-detection for Stripe, LemonSqueezy, and Polar
- Filter every query by country, device, UTM source, page, channel, and 15+ other dimensions
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `flowsery` (Query web analytics data from Flowsery Analytics — a privacy-first web analytics platform).

Installs with `claude plugin install flowsery@claude-community` from `Flowsery/claude-plugin`.

Query web analytics from Claude Code — real-time visitors, traffic breakdowns, revenue, goals, and full visitor profiles. Privacy-first, cookie-free analytics. Alternative to Google Analytics.
